<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Semangat, Fitri</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@1,9..144,600&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#fff1ea;--ink:#3a1a2e;--rose:#e0457b;--peach:#ffb48a;--plum:#7a3a6b;--card:#fffaf7;--soft:#f9d9e2;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#241024;--ink:#ffe9ef;--rose:#ff7aa8;--peach:#ffb48a;--plum:#e9b6d8;--card:#341a35;--soft:#4a2447;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#241024;--ink:#ffe9ef;--rose:#ff7aa8;--peach:#ffb48a;--plum:#e9b6d8;--card:#341a35;--soft:#4a2447;color-scheme:dark}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 1.05rem/1.7 Nunito,system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden;min-height:100vh}
.sky{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;z-index:0}
.sky i{position:absolute;bottom:-40px;color:var(--rose);opacity:.0;font-style:normal;animation:rise linear infinite}
@keyframes rise{0%{transform:translateY(0) translateX(0) rotate(-10deg);opacity:0}15%{opacity:.35}100%{transform:translateY(-110vh) translateX(30px) rotate(12deg);opacity:0}}
main{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px 22px 64px}
.hero{display:grid;gap:36px;align-items:center;min-height:86vh}
@media(min-width:780px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr}}
h1{font:italic 600 clamp(3rem,10vw,5.6rem)/1 Fraunces,Georgia,serif;margin:0 0 18px;color:var(--plum);letter-spacing:-.02em}
h1 span{display:inline-block;animation:pop .7s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1) both}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(.6em) scale(.7)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.lead{max-width:30em;margin:0 0 26px}
button{font:800 1rem Nunito,sans-serif;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:14px 26px;background:var(--rose);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;box-shadow:0 8px 22px -8px var(--rose)}
button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}button:active{transform:scale(.96)}
button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--peach);outline-offset:3px}
#msg{min-height:4.2em;margin:22px 0 0;font:italic 600 1.4rem/1.35 Fraunces,Georgia,serif;color:var(--ink);transition:opacity .3s}
.arch{position:relative;justify-self:center;width:min(100%,380px);animation:bob 6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
.arch img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 28%;border-radius:999px 999px 28px 28px;border:6px solid var(--card);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -25px var(--rose)}
.arch:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14px;border:2px dashed var(--peach);border-radius:999px 999px 40px 40px;animation:spin 30s linear infinite alternate}
@keyframes spin{from{transform:rotate(-1.5deg)}to{transform:rotate(1.5deg)}}
.arch b{position:absolute;right:-8px;bottom:22px;background:var(--card);color:var(--rose);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 16px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 6px 16px -6px #0003;transform:rotate(6deg)}
section{margin-top:80px}
h2{font:italic 600 clamp(1.8rem,5vw,2.6rem)/1.15 Fraunces,Georgia,serif;color:var(--plum);margin:0 0 20px}
.notes p{margin:0;padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--soft);font:600 clamp(1.1rem,3vw,1.5rem)/1.4 Nunito,sans-serif;max-width:30em}
.notes p:last-child{border:0}
.duo{display:grid;gap:36px;align-items:center}
@media(min-width:780px){.duo{grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr}}
.polaroid{justify-self:center;width:min(100%,290px);background:#fff;padding:12px 12px 18px;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 24px 40px -20px #0006;transform:rotate(-4deg);transition:transform .4s;color:#3a1a2e}
.polaroid:hover,.polaroid:focus-within{transform:rotate(0) scale(1.03)}
.polaroid img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 40%;border-radius:3px}
.polaroid figcaption{font:italic 600 1.1rem Fraunces,serif;text-align:center;padding-top:12px}
.breathe{text-align:center}
.ring{width:150px;height:150px;margin:20px auto 10px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--peach),var(--rose));display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-weight:800;animation:br 8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes br{0%,100%{transform:scale(.7)}50%{transform:scale(1.15)}}
footer{margin-top:80px;text-align:center;font:italic 600 1.3rem Fraunces,serif;color:var(--plum)}
.fly{position:fixed;z-index:9;pointer-events:none;font-size:22px;color:var(--rose)}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sky,.arch:before{display:none}.arch,.ring,h1 span{animation:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="sky" id="sky" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<main>
  <div class="hero">
    <div>
      <h1 id="title">Semangat, Fitri.</h1>
      <p class="lead">Halaman kecil ini dibuat khusus untukmu. Kalau hari ini terasa berat, mampir sebentar ke sini ya.</p>
      <button id="go" type="button">Kasih aku semangat ♥</button>
      <p id="msg" aria-live="polite">Tekan tombolnya, ada pesan untukmu.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="arch">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Foto Fitri tersenyum">
      <b>kamu hebat</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <section class="notes">
    <h2>Pengingat kecil buat kamu</h2>
    <p>Kamu sudah melangkah sejauh ini, dan itu bukan hal kecil.</p>
    <p>Capek itu boleh. Menyerah, tidak perlu.</p>
    <p>Pelan-pelan juga tetap maju.</p>
    <p>Ada aku yang selalu bangga sama kamu.</p>
  </section>

  <section class="duo">
    <figure class="polaroid" style="margin:0 auto">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Foto selfie Fitri dengan filter telinga anjing">
      <figcaption>Senyum yang bikin hariku cerah</figcaption>
    </figure>
    <div>
      <h2>Senyummu itu semangatku</h2>
      <p>Setiap kamu tertawa, hari-hariku ikut ringan. Jadi kalau kamu lagi lelah, ingat: kamu punya seseorang yang percaya penuh sama kamu. Apa pun yang kamu kerjakan hari ini, kamu pasti bisa.</p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="breathe">
    <h2>Tarik napas dulu, yuk</h2>
    <div class="ring" id="ring">Tarik</div>
    <p>Ikuti lingkarannya. Satu menit saja sudah cukup.</p>
  </section>

  <footer>Dari aku, dengan sayang. ♥</footer>
</main>
<script>
(function(){
var reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
var t=document.getElementById('title'),txt=t.textContent;t.setAttribute('aria-label',txt);t.textContent='';
txt.split('').forEach(function(c,i){var s=document.createElement('span');s.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');s.textContent=c===' '?'\u00a0':c;s.style.animationDelay=(i*60)+'ms';t.appendChild(s)});
var sky=document.getElementById('sky');
if(!reduce){for(var i=0;i<14;i++){var h=document.createElement('i');h.textContent='♥';h.style.left=(Math.random()*100)+'%';h.style.fontSize=(12+Math.random()*22)+'px';h.style.animationDuration=(9+Math.random()*10)+'s';h.style.animationDelay=(-Math.random()*15)+'s';sky.appendChild(h)}}
var msgs=['Kamu lebih kuat dari yang kamu kira.','Satu langkah kecil hari ini sudah cukup.','Aku percaya sama kamu, sepenuhnya.','Kamu boleh istirahat, tapi jangan berhenti percaya sama dirimu.','Hari berat pasti lewat, dan aku di sini.','Terima kasih sudah berusaha sekeras ini.','Kamu itu luar biasa, jangan lupa ya.','Semangat, sayang! Kamu pasti bisa.'];
var n=-1,msg=document.getElementById('msg');
document.getElementById('go').addEventListener('click',function(e){
  n=(n+1+Math.floor(Math.random()*3))%msgs.length;
  msg.style.opacity=0;setTimeout(function(){msg.textContent=msgs[n];msg.style.opacity=1},250);
  if(reduce||!document.body.animate)return;
  var r=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(),x=r.left+r.width/2,y=r.top+r.height/2;
  for(var i=0;i<16;i++){var f=document.createElement('span');f.className='fly';f.textContent='♥';f.style.left=x+'px';f.style.top=y+'px';f.style.color=i%2?'#e0457b':'#ffb48a';document.body.appendChild(f);
    var a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,d=70+Math.random()*110;
    f.animate([{transform:'translate(0,0) scale(.4)',opacity:1},{transform:'translate('+Math.cos(a)*d+'px,'+(Math.sin(a)*d-60)+'px) scale(1.2)',opacity:0}],{duration:900+Math.random()*400,easing:'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1)'}).onfinish=(function(el){return function(){el.remove()}})(f);
  }
});
var ring=document.getElementById('ring'),k=0;
setInterval(function(){k^=1;ring.textContent=k?'Hembus':'Tarik'},4000);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
